To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) nicotine enhances LTP induced by cocaine; (b) nicotine primes the effect of a single cocaine injection; (c) nicotine primes the response to cocaine for up to 7 days after the last injection of nicotine; and (d) the priming effect is reversible and can be obtained for at least 24 days, but not for 40 days, after cessation of nicotine treatment.
